VIDEO SCRIPT: BASIC CHANTS/MANTRAS AS PER BUDDHISM
Grade: Grade 6 · Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment
• describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth
• appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment
• Model 2: describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth
• Model 3: appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment
• Practise: describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth
• Practise: appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism.”
